claims: Approximately 30 to 35 countries worldwide offer unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli)
Unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli) automatically grants citizenship to children born within their territory regardless of their parents' citizenship
Unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli) is primarily found in the Americas
The United States offers unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli)
Canada offers unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli)
Mexico offers unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli)
Argentina offers unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli)
Brazil offers unrestricted birthright citizenship (jus soli)
